news.title: Nathalie Bjorn on why facing Hacken will be 'no walk in the park'
news.title_zh: 娜塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 解释为什么面对哈肯将“不像在公园散步”
news.body_en: Nathalie Bjorn is back in her native Sweden this week as we take on Hacken in the Women’s Champions League, with the defender hitting form at the perfect moment. Leaving behind last season’s injury battle, Bjorn enjoyed her first start for the Blues this season in the 6-0 WSL win over Charlton, leading the side out as captain. The day couldn’t have gone much better for Bjorn as she opened the scoring with a header after just three minutes at The Valley. As she explains when she sits down to talk to us ahead of the trip to Sweden, she’s feeling excited for the rest of the campaign. ‘It’s been good,’ Bjorn says. ‘I’m taking it day by day, and I’m very happy that my body is feeling good. 'It’s difficult coming back from a long-term injury, in terms of having the quality on the pitch and getting back to my old self. I know it will take time, so I’m trying to be open-minded and grateful that my body is doing what I want it to do. ‘I want to push my standards even higher, and I feel like I still have a few steps to go before I’m back to my prior self. But the season has been good. The team has been amazing and performed really well, and I think this is a very exciting season for us. ‘It was a really nice feeling to walk out with the armband and have the girls with me,' adds Nat. 'A proud moment for me, and obviously even better to score the goal. It was my first start in almost a year at Chelsea, which made it a really nice feeling. ‘We had loads of different goalscorers, and players who haven’t played as much this season got the chance to prove themselves. The game really showed the quality we have in the squad this year.’ Talking with Bjorn is an ideal opportunity for us to glean some insight into Tuesday night’s opponents and the wider Swedish league. From what she describes, the Blues supporters can expect a fascinating evening in Gothenburg. ‘Hacken are a good team,’ she explains. ‘Some of them are my team-mates in the national team. I played with their head coach before, and I know she’s a very good, very passionate coach. I played with their captain Anna Anvegard at Everton. I know them really well. ‘They are a hard-working side, and they’ve done well in Europe in previous seasons, so it’s not going to be a walk in the park for us. They also have a big supporter group at their home games, so I think it’s going to be an amazing atmosphere. I’m looking forward to it. ‘A few years back, the Swedish league was one of the biggest leagues in the world, with players such as Marta da Silva, Lotta Schelin and Christen Press,’ she tells us. 'There are loads of good Swedish players, too. ‘The number of players coming from the Swedish league to the English league proves that the quality there is really good. I took the step from the Swedish league to England myself. It’s a good league for preparing players to go out and play in Europe.' Bjorn moved to the Women’s Super League when she joined Everton back in 2021. We ask her about the difference between life in Scandinavia and England, and what she misses about home. ‘England is quite similar in a way, which is really nice,’ she smiles. ‘It feels like a home away from home. It’s easy to adapt to. Of course, there are different traditions and different types of food – I would say that’s maybe the biggest difference. ‘When I first came to England, it was an easy transition because we learn English in school. So with that and the culture being quite similar, it makes it really easy. ‘I miss the Swedish food. I miss Swedish pick and mix! Every time my parents or my siblings come over, I always ask them to bring some. I really miss Swedish cheese. We eat breakfast with hard bread and butter, and then we slice the cheese up. ‘But here we don’t have exactly the same assortment, or you buy slices already cut, and they’re quite thick, but I like them a bit thinner. It goes in phases, but right now, I miss the cheese and also liquorice!’ Bjorn will have a brief moment to sample those home comforts before focus turns to business. Today's task is returning to London with three more Champions League points.
news.body_zh: 娜塔莉·比约恩本周回到了她的祖国瑞典，我们将在女子冠军联赛中对阵哈肯，这位后卫在完美的时刻打出了状态。抛开上赛季的伤病之战，比约恩在 WSL 6-0 战胜查尔顿的比赛中以队长身份带领球队完成了本赛季的蓝军首次首发。对于比约恩来说，这一天再好不过了，她在山谷球场仅仅三分钟后就以头球首开纪录。正如她在前往瑞典之前坐下来与我们交谈时解释的那样，她对竞选活动的其余部分感到兴奋。 “这很好，”比约恩说。 “我每天都在服用，我很高兴我的身体感觉很好。 “从长期伤病中恢复过来，在球场上保持良好的状态并找回以前的自己是很困难的。我知道这需要时间，所以我努力保持开放的态度，并感激我的身体正在做我想做的事情。 “我想把自己的标准提高得更高，而且我觉得在回到以前的自己之前，我还有几步路要走。”但这个赛季表现不错。这支球队非常棒，表现也非常好，我认为这对我们来说是一个非常激动人心的赛季。纳特补充道：“带着臂章走出去，并让女孩们和我在一起，这种感觉真的很好。” “对我来说这是一个值得骄傲的时刻，显然进球更好。这是我在切尔西近一年来第一次首发，这让我感觉非常好。 “我们有很多不同的射手，本赛季出场次数不多的球员有机会证明自己。这场比赛确实展示了我们今年球队的实力。”与比约恩交谈是我们了解周二晚上的对手和更广泛的瑞典联赛的理想机会。根据她的描述，蓝军支持者可以期待在哥德堡度过一个迷人的夜晚。 “哈肯是一支优秀的团队，”她解释道。 “他们中的一些人是我在国家队的队友。我以前和他们的主教练一起打过球，我知道她是一位非常优秀、非常热情的教练。我在埃弗顿和他们的队长安娜·安维加德一起踢球。我非常了解他们。 “他们是一支勤奋的球队，前几个赛季他们在欧洲表现出色，所以这对我们来说并不是一件容易的事。他们在主场比赛中也有一个庞大的支持者群体，所以我认为这将是一个令人惊叹的氛围。我很期待。 “几年前，瑞典联赛是世界上最大的联赛之一，拥有玛塔·达席尔瓦、洛塔·谢林和克里斯滕·普雷斯等球员，”她告诉我们。 “瑞典也有很多优秀的球员。 “从瑞典联赛来到英格兰联赛的球员数量证明了那里的质量非常好。我自己从瑞典联赛来到了英格兰。这是一个很好的联赛，可以让球员为去欧洲踢球做好准备。”比约恩于 2021 年加盟埃弗顿后转投女子超级联赛。我们询问她斯堪的纳维亚半岛和英格兰的生活有何不同，以及她对家乡的思念。 “英格兰在某种程度上非常相似，这真的很好，”她微笑着说。 ‘感觉就像一个家外之家。很容易适应。当然，有不同的传统和不同类型的食物——我想说这可能是最大的区别。 “当我第一次来到英国时，这是一个很容易的过渡，因为我们在学校学习英语。因此，由于这一点和文化非常相似，这使得事情变得非常容易。 “我想念瑞典食物。我想念瑞典的挑选和混合！每次我的父母或兄弟姐妹过来时，我总是要求他们带一些。我真的很想念瑞典奶酪。我们吃早餐时会吃硬面包和黄油，然后把奶酪切成薄片。 “但我们这里没有完全相同的品种，或者你买的是已经切好的切片，它们很厚，但我喜欢薄一点。”它分阶段进行，但现在，我想念奶酪和甘草！”在焦点转向业务之前，比约恩将有短暂的时间品尝这些家庭舒适感。今天的任务是带着欧冠三分回到伦敦。

news.title: Bompastor on latest team news and needing to be at our best against Hacken
news.title_zh: Bompastor 了解最新的球队新闻，并需要在对阵哈肯的比赛中发挥最佳水平
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor feels that Tuesday night's UEFA Women's Champions League fixture against Hacken has come at exactly the right time to help Chelsea shake off Saturday's disappointing 1-1 draw with Everton in domestic action. The stalemate with the Toffees saw Sandy Baltimore put us in front with a header, but an unfortunate own goal from Lucy Bronze levelled the scores. And despite our best efforts in the second half, we couldn't put ourselves back in front. There's little time between Saturday afternoon's final whistle and Tuesday's 5.45pm kick-off (UK time) in Gothenburg, but Bompastor feels that it will be good to get back out on the pitch quickly to shake off the result against Everton. And aside from Naomi Girma and Lauren James, who were not part of the travelling squad, the head coach confirmed she has a full complement to pick from. 'All the other players are fit and available,' said Bompastor, before going on to discuss our impressive record in the Champions League, in which we have not conceded a single goal in our opening three league phase encounters. 'It’s important for us to stay in that good form, especially on the back of a disappointing result at the weekend. 'In this competition we also have ambitions, and right now we are in the top four. That’s the goal: we want to be in the top four and stay there. So we want to put in a good performance and get a good result tomorrow. Staying strong defensively, not conceding too much and keeping a clean sheet would be a good thing.' In a match where we had 65 per cent possession and fired 20 shots towards goal against Everton, the head coach said she was frustrated not to take all three points. But football moves on quickly, and Bompastor wants to take the opportunity to put in an improved display against Hacken. 'I think the frustration came from the result because we have ambitions, and dropping two points at home is never good, but it happens. The good thing with a quick turnaround is you analyse the game and give the players feedback, but you also need to move on. You need to focus on something new. We have a new game coming, in a new competition, so it’s the best thing for us in terms of moving on.' Hacken were crowned Swedish champions for the second year running last week, and won the inaugural Women’s Europa Cup last season. However, their Champions League campaign has been tougher, with defeats to Inter and Juventus followed by a 1-1 draw away at Paris FC, secured by a 93rd-minute equaliser. Bompastor believes those results haven’t reflected Hacken’s performances, and she warned of the threats they carry. 'Hacken's Champions League results didn’t necessarily reflect their performances on the pitch,' Bompastor explained. 'They have strengths and threats, especially in the attacking line, with speed and pace. So we will have to be really careful in the transitional moments of the game. 'For me, it’s important we find the right balance between focusing on ourselves and making sure we don’t give them many opportunities. They are playing at home, so they’ll want a good result, and we need to be at our best tomorrow.'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特认为，周二晚上对阵哈肯的欧洲女子冠军联赛比赛来得正是时候，帮助切尔西摆脱了周六在国内比赛中令人失望的 1-1 战平埃弗顿的局面。在与太妃糖队的平局中，桑迪·巴尔的摩的头球帮助我们取得领先，但不幸的是露西·布朗泽的乌龙球将比分扳平。尽管我们在下半场尽了最大努力，但我们还是没能重新领先。从周六下午的终场哨声吹响到周二下午 5.45 分在哥德堡开球（英国时间）之间的时间很短，但邦帕斯特认为，尽快回到球场上摆脱对埃弗顿的比赛结果将是件好事。除了娜奥米·吉尔玛和劳伦·詹姆斯不在随行阵容之外，主教练确认她还有完整的阵容可供选择。 “所有其他球员都健康并且可以上场，”邦帕斯托尔说道，然后继续讨论我们在冠军联赛中令人印象深刻的记录，我们在联赛的前三阶段比赛中没有丢过一个球。 “对我们来说保持良好的状态很重要，尤其是在周末令人失望的结果之后。 “这次比赛我们也有雄心，现在我们已经进入前四了。这就是我们的目标：我们希望进入前四并保持在那里。所以我们希望明天有好的表现并取得好的结果。保持坚强的防守，不失太多，保持不失球将是一件好事。”在一场对阵埃弗顿的比赛中，我们控球率为 65%，并射出 20 次射门，主教练表示她对未能全取三分感到沮丧。但足球比赛进展很快，邦帕斯特希望借此机会在对阵哈肯的比赛中提高自己的表现。 “我认为沮丧来自于结果，因为我们有雄心，在主场丢两分从来都不是好事，但这种情况确实发生了。快速周转的好处是你可以分析游戏并向玩家提供反馈，但你也需要继续前进。你需要专注于新事物。我们即将迎来一场新的比赛，一场新的比赛，所以这对我们继续前进来说是最好的事情。”哈肯上周连续第二年加冕瑞典冠军，并在上赛季赢得了首届女子欧洲杯冠军。然而，他们的欧冠之旅更加艰难，先后输给国际米兰和尤文图斯，随后又客场1-1战平巴黎FC，并在第93分钟扳平比分。邦帕斯托认为这些结果并没有反映哈肯的表现，她警告说这些结果带来的威胁。 “哈肯的欧冠成绩并不一定反映他们在球场上的表现，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “他们有优势和威胁，尤其是在进攻线上，速度和节奏。所以我们在比赛的过渡时刻必须非常小心。 “对我来说，重要的是我们在关注自己和确保不给他们太多机会之间找到适当的平衡。他们是在主场比赛，所以他们想要一个好的结果，而我们明天需要发挥出最好的状态。”

news.title: Chelsea Women travelling squad confirmed for Hacken
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足随队确认哈肯
news.body_en: A 23-player Chelsea squad has been confirmed for the Women's Champions League match away at Hacken. The Blues sit joint-second in the UEFA Women's Champions League table, with seven points earned from wins over Austria Vienna and Roma at home, plus a hard-fought goalless draw away at Lyon. Tomorrow's match, held at the Hisingen Arena in Gothenburg, kicks off at 6.45pm local time (5.45pm UK). You can listen to live commentary and follow minute-by-minute text updates in our Match Centre. Naomi Girma and Lauren James will not travel as both are ruled out through injury. Captain Erin Cuthbert joins the travelling squad for a European fixture for the first time this season after completing her recovery from injury. It's a big week for Chelsea as, following our trip to Sweden, we will return to domestic action with a game against Women's Super League leaders Manchester City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday at 1.30pm. You can buy tickets for that blockbuster clash here. Our next home European action is against French side Paris Saint-Germain at Plough Lane on 18 November. See below for the full list of players travelling to Sweden... Goalkeepers: Hannah Hampton, Livia Peng, Becky Spencer Defenders: Nathalie Bjorn, Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan, Veerle Buurman, Ellie Carpenter, Nelly Las, Katie McCabe Midfielders: Lola Brown, Erin Cuthbert, Giulia Dragoni, Wieke Kaptein, Sjoeke Nusken, Lexi Potter, Keira Walsh Forwards: Sandy Baltimore, Aggie Beever-Jones, Maika Hamano, Manaka Matsukubo, Melvine Malard, Alyssa Thompson
news.body_zh: 切尔西队的 23 名球员已确定参加客场对阵哈肯的女子冠军联赛比赛。蓝军在欧洲女足欧冠积分榜上排名并列第二，主场战胜奥地利维也纳和罗马积7分，客场0-0战平里昂。明天的比赛将在哥德堡希辛根体育场举行，将于当地时间下午 6.45 分（英国下午 5.45 分）开始。您可以在我们的比赛中心收听现场评论并关注每分钟的文本更新。娜奥米·吉尔玛和劳伦·詹姆斯将不会参加比赛，因为两人都因伤缺席。队长艾琳·库斯伯特在伤愈康复后，本赛季首次随队参加欧洲比赛。对于切尔西来说，这是重要的一周，在瑞典之行之后，我们将重返国内赛场，周六下午 1 点 30 分在斯坦福桥对阵女足超级联赛领头羊曼城。您可以在这里购买那场轰动一时的比赛的门票。我们的下一场欧洲主场比赛是 11 月 18 日在普劳巷对阵法国球队巴黎圣日耳曼队。请参阅下文，了解前往瑞典的完整球员名单...守门员：汉娜·汉普顿、莉维亚·彭、贝基·斯宾塞 后卫：纳塔莉·比约恩、露西·青铜、卡德伊沙·布坎南、维尔勒·布尔曼、埃莉·卡彭特、内莉·拉斯、凯蒂·麦凯布 中场：洛拉·布朗、艾琳·库斯伯特、朱利亚·德拉戈尼、维克·卡普坦、斯乔克努斯肯、莱克西·波特、凯拉·沃尔什 前锋：桑迪·巴尔的摩、阿吉·比弗-琼斯、滨野麦卡、松久保真中、梅尔文·马拉德、艾莉莎·汤普森

news.title: Chelsea Women's Constant Contact October Goal of the Month revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足十月持续接触十月最佳进球揭晓！
news.body_en: Maika Hamano's sublime strike against Tottenham Hotspur in the Women's Super League has been voted as our Constant Contact Goal of the Month for October! Hamano came on after half-time against Spurs, and she marked her appearance against her former loan club with a stunning swerving effort from almost 30 yards out. The replays showed just how much the ball moved once it had left her foot, and the goal certainly got the Blues fans off their seats at Stamford Bridge. Her strike was the clear winner among Blues fans, receiving 60 per cent of all votes cast. Lauren James' superb effort in the same game against Spurs at the Bridge finished second with 16 per cent, while Melvine Malard's shot from range against Crystal Palace received nine per cent and was ranked in third place.
news.body_zh: 滨野舞香在女子超级联赛中对阵托特纳姆热刺队的精彩进球被评选为我们十月月度持续接触进球！滨野在对阵热刺的比赛中场休息后登场，她在对阵她的前租借俱乐部的比赛中以一记令人惊叹的近 30 码外的转身射门标志着自己的出场。回放显示了球一旦离开她的脚就会移动多少，而这个进球无疑让斯坦福桥的蓝军球迷离开了座位。她的进球在蓝军球迷中明显获胜，获得了所有投票的 60%。劳伦·詹姆斯在蓝桥对阵热刺的同一场比赛中以16%的出色射门排名第二，而梅尔文·马拉德对阵水晶宫的远射命中率高达9%，排名第三。

news.title: Chelsea Women vs Hacken: How to watch, TV channel, kick-off time, date
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足 vs 哈肯：如何观看、电视频道、开球时间、日期
news.body_en: Chelsea's UEFA Women's Champions League campaign continues as we travel to Sweden to face Hacken on Tuesday evening. The Blues are unbeaten in Europe this season and are yet to concede after three matches of the league phase. We will be looking for our first away win of the campaign as the Champions League returns to the top of the agenda in midweek. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Hacken against Chelsea Women, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Hacken takes place on Tuesday 10 November at Hisingen Arena, with kick-off scheduled for 5.45pm UK time (6.45pm local time). The match will be shown live in the UK on Disney+. As always, you can follow minute-by-minute updates in our Hacken vs Chelsea Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. You can also follow through Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook and Instagram. Chelsea are yet to lose or concede in this season's Champions League, beating Austria Vienna 1-0 and Roma 2-0 at Plough Lane, either side of a goalless draw away at Lyon. That run has extended our record-breaking unbeaten streak in league phase and group stage fixtures to 27 games. Hacken, last season's Women's Europa Cup winners, arrive as newly crowned Damallsvenskan champions, having lost just once in 25 league games. However, in Europe, they are still looking for a first win, with defeats to Inter and Juventus followed by a 1-1 draw away at Paris FC. Chelsea are unbeaten in two previous meetings with Hacken, both in the group stage of the 2023/24 Women's Champions League. A goalless draw at Stamford Bridge was followed six days later by a 3-1 win in Gothenburg, with a goal from Sam Kerr and an Erin Cuthbert brace.

news.title: Xabi Alonso calls for consistency after ‘ups and downs’
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索呼吁在“起起落落”后保持稳定
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso knows there were positives and negatives from his Chelsea team’s performances since the October international break, but wants to see the Blues hitting our top level more consistently when we return from the latest one. We enter the November break – the last of this year, with the next interruption to the club football schedule not arriving until March 2027 – off the back of a loss, as a first-half penalty condemned us to a narrow 1-0 defeat away at Sunderland on Sunday. That is a repeat of the previous international window, in late September and early October, when we were beaten at Brentford in our final game leading into the break. Since then, results have been mixed. Strong wins over Bournemouth, Everton and Manchester United – bringing our first two Premier League clean sheets of the season in the process – were offset by our exit from the Carabao Cup in a penalty shoot-out at Liverpool and league defeats to Tottenham Hotspur and, now, Sunderland. It was that inconsistency in league results and performance which was on our manager’s mind when he was asked for his opinion on how this run of fixtures has gone for the Blues. ‘Three wins, two defeats, it could have been better,’ reflected Alonso. ‘It’s progress, but we want to be more consistent. ‘It was about finishing this block with a good feeling but, like the last block against Brentford, we lost. ‘For sure, it’s ups and downs, and we are still missing that consistency that is needed in the Premier League.' The good news is that Alonso, his staff, and those members of his squad who aren’t heading away to join their national teams in the coming days, now have time to plan and prepare to put that right in time for the Premier League’s return. That comes on Saturday 21 November, when Chelsea will host old rivals Leeds United at Stamford Bridge. We will be looking to get straight back to winning ways after this international break, just as we did last time around by thrashing Bournemouth 5-1 in west London on our return to the pitch. ‘The plan is to use the time with the players we have,’ Xabi added on his plans for the international break. ‘Some players will go on international duties, but we keep working.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索知道，自十月国际比赛日以来，他的切尔西队的表现有积极的一面，也有消极的一面，但他希望看到蓝军在最近一场比赛归来后能够更稳定地达到我们的顶级水平。由于一场失利，我们进入了 11 月份的休息期——今年的最后一次，俱乐部足球赛程的下一次中断要到 2027 年 3 月才会到来——上半场的点球让我们在周日客场以 1-0 险胜桑德兰。这是上一个国际比赛窗口的重演，九月底和十月初，当时我们在中场休息前的最后一场比赛中在布伦特福德被击败。从那时起，结果好坏参半。对阵伯恩茅斯、埃弗顿和曼联的强劲胜利——我们在英超联赛中取得了本赛季前两场不失球——但我们在卡拉宝杯中在利物浦的点球大战中被淘汰，以及联赛中输给托特纳姆热刺和现在的桑德兰，这些都抵消了我们的影响。当我们的主教练被问及对蓝军这轮比赛的进展有何看法时，他想到的正是联赛成绩和表现的不一致。 “三场胜利，两场失败，本来可以更好，”阿隆索反映道。 “这是进步，但我们希望更加一致。 “我们的目标是带着良好的感觉完成这个拦网，但就像对阵布伦特福德的最后一个拦网一样，我们输了。 “当然，这有起有落，我们仍然缺少英超联赛所需的一致性。”好消息是，阿隆索、他的工作人员以及他的球队中那些在未来几天不会前往加入国家队的成员，现在有时间计划和准备，以便在英超联赛回归之前及时做好准备。 11 月 21 日星期六，切尔西将在斯坦福桥迎战老对手利兹联。我们将寻求在国际比赛日结束后直接回到胜利之路，就像我们上次回到球场时在伦敦西部以 5-1 击败伯恩茅斯一样。 “我们的计划是利用与我们现有球员相处的时间，”哈维在谈到国际比赛日的计划时补充道。 “有些球员会继续履行国际职责，但我们会继续努力。”

news.body_en: The first cashback window for supporters who have sold general admission tickets on the ticket exchange will open tomorrow. You can use account credit from ticket sales towards future ticket purchases, including season ticket renewals, or you can withdraw the credit to a bank account during one of the season’s three dedicated withdrawal windows. The first withdrawal window of the 2026/27 season opens at 12pm on Tuesday 10 November and runs until 12pm on Monday 23 November. Please log in to your account on the ticketing portal and when the window is open: Select VIEW ACCOUNT MENU under the head and shoulders icon in the top right-hand corner Then select ACCOUNT CASHBACK, which will appear in the dropdown menu You can then enter your bank account details and the amount to transfer Once the details are entered, click on TRANSFER FUNDS When the process is complete, you will receive a TRANSFER SUCCESSFUL message on screen and an email confirmation of the cashback request If you look in your ACCOUNT HISTORY, you will see confirmation of the cashback request If you do not have a UK bank account Please complete the submission form, which can be accessed by clicking here and then email tickets@chelseafc.com during the above withdrawal window open period with proof of account for verification. If you would prefer your balance to remain in your account to be used towards future purchases, you do not have to take any action. Funds will be transferred to your nominated bank account within 10 working days of the window closing, provided your request has been successfully received. Before submitting your request, carefully check the bank account details and withdrawal amount. You cannot amend a request once it has been sent. Only you can submit the request, and you are responsible for ensuring your details are correct and your account is secure. news.title: Chelsea Diary: Big week for CFCW culminates in Man City showdown
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：CFCW 的重要一周在曼城对决中达到顶峰
news.body_en: European football and a huge domestic test for Chelsea Women headline the week ahead, while the men's team enter the final international break of 2026. Sonia Bompastor's side have two important fixtures to look forward to, beginning with a trip to Sweden in the Champions League before welcoming Manchester City to Stamford Bridge in the WSL. There will also be plenty to follow away from club football, with several Chelsea players representing their countries. Here are just some of the highlights to look out for across the next seven days… We begin the week by reflecting on our defeat to Sunderland, with post-match words from Xabi Alonso and Mike Penders as well as a full replay of the game. Attention will then turn towards Chelsea Women’s trip to play Hacken, starting with the first 15 minutes of their training session being broadcast live on the Chelsea Official App and website. Coverage will start at 10.45am. Later in the day, Bompastor and one of her players will be answering the media’s questions in Gothenburg. That press conference, at 6.45pm UK time, will also be shown live on our channels. We will also bring you news of which of our men’s players will be on international duty this window. Chelsea Women take on Hacken at the Hisingen Arena for a 5.45pm kick-off. We are searching for our third win in the competition this season, and Nathalie Bjorn will be previewing the fixture in her homeland in an exclusive interview. We will bring supporters all the latest team news and build-up ahead of the game, with live coverage, updates and reaction available on the Chelsea Official App and website. We’ll have further reaction and analysis from the game in Sweden, as well as the best of the action. There will be an exclusive interview with Romeo Lavia, so impressive in recent weeks, discussing his footballing firsts. The first of our international round-ups will include news of England’s game against Croatia at Wembley. Belgium and France are also in action. For Chelsea Women, the focus will firmly shift towards the weekend meeting with title rivals Manchester City. It is undoubtedly one of the standout fixtures in the WSL calendar, and we will carry words from several of our players about what having Stamford Bridge as our permanent home has been like. Bompastor will face the media to preview that game on Friday afternoon, and we will bring you the key talking points from her press conference, including the latest team news. Captain Erin Cuthbert also speaks exclusively to us ahead of the big match as we seek to reclaim top spot in the table. Kick-off at the Bridge is at 1.30pm - with tickets still available to buy – and our final preview beforehand is with Kadeisha Buchanan. The match will be broadcast live on BBC One in the UK, while supporters can follow all the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and reaction in our Chelsea Women vs Manchester City Match Centre. We will also bring supporters the best of the action after the final whistle, including a match report, highlights and reaction from Bompastor and her players. As well as further reaction to the Manchester City game, we round off the week with further international action involving our men's players. England travel to Madrid to take on Spain in their second UEFA Nations League fixture of the November window, with Morgan Rogers hoping to feature for the Three Lions. We will also have a long read on the 30th anniversary of the signing of the great Gianfranco Zola.
news.body_zh: 欧洲足球和切尔西女足将在未来一周面临巨大的国内考验，而男队则进入 2026 年最后的国际比赛日。索尼娅·邦帕斯托的球队有两场重要的比赛值得期待，首先是欧洲冠军联赛的瑞典之旅，然后是在斯坦福桥迎战曼城的 WSL。俱乐部足球之外还有很多值得关注的事情，几名切尔西球员将代表自己的国家出战。以下是未来 7 天内需要关注的一些亮点……我们以哈比·阿隆索和迈克·彭德斯的赛后言论以及比赛的完整重播来回顾我们输给桑德兰的比赛开始本周。随后，注意力将转向切尔西女足对阵哈肯的比赛，从切尔西官方应用程序和网站上直播的前 15 分钟训练开始。报道将于上午 10.45 开始。当天晚些时候，邦帕斯特和她的一名球员将在哥德堡回答媒体提问。英国时间下午 6.45 举行的新闻发布会也将在我们的频道上直播。我们还将为您带来有关我们哪些男子球员将在这个窗口执行国际任务的消息。切尔西女足将于下午 5 点 45 分在希辛根体育场迎战哈肯。我们正在寻求本赛季比赛的第三场胜利，娜塔莉·比约恩将在她的祖国接受独家采访，预览这场比赛。我们将在比赛前为支持者带来所有最新的球队新闻和集结，并在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上提供现场报道、更新和反应。我们将从瑞典的比赛以及最佳比赛中得到进一步的反应和分析。罗密欧·拉维亚（Romeo Lavia）将接受独家采访，他在最近几周的表现令人印象深刻，讨论他的足球生涯第一次。我们的第一个国际综述将包括英格兰在温布利对阵克罗地亚的比赛的新闻。比利时和法国也在行动。对于切尔西女足来说，焦点将坚定地转向周末与争冠对手曼城的比赛。这无疑是 WSL 日历中最出色的比赛之一，我们将转述几位球员的心声，讲述以斯坦福桥作为我们永久主场的感受。邦帕斯特将于周五下午面对媒体预览这场比赛，我们将为您带来她新闻发布会上的要点，包括最新的球队新闻。队长艾琳·库斯伯特也在这场重要比赛前与我们进行了独家对话，因为我们正在寻求重新夺回积分榜的榜首位置。大桥的开赛时间为下午 1.30，门票仍可购买，我们将与卡黛莎·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 一起进行最后的预演。这场比赛将在英国的 BBC One 进行现场直播，而支持者可以在我们的切尔西女足对阵曼城比赛中心关注所有的赛前准备、确认的球队新闻、每分钟的更新和反应。我们还将在终场哨响后为球迷们带来精彩的比赛内容，包括比赛报告、亮点以及 Bompastor 和她的球员的反应。除了对曼城比赛的进一步反应之外，我们还以涉及我们男子球员的进一步国际行动来结束本周。英格兰将前往马德里，在 11 月份欧洲国家联赛的第二场比赛中迎战西班牙，摩根·罗杰斯希望代表三狮军团出场。我们还将长篇阅读伟大的詹弗兰科·佐拉签约 30 周年。

news.title: Mike Penders focused on ‘staying together’ after difficult Sunderland defeat
news.title_zh: 迈克·彭德斯在艰难击败桑德兰后专注于“团结一致”
news.body_en: Mike Penders did not hide from the disappointment and frustration felt in the Chelsea dressing room after Sunday’s loss at Sunderland. A tight contest at the Stadium of Light was decided by Enzo Le Fee’s first-half penalty. The Blues enjoyed plenty of possession and territory, especially after the break, but couldn’t create clear opportunities against a resolute Black Cats rearguard. Besides one outstanding save in the second period to deny Wilson Isidor, Penders didn’t have a great deal to do, either. But the damage had been done and one goal proved enough for Sunderland’s second league win of the season. ‘Very disappointed with the result,’ Penders said. ‘You know when you come here to their stadium that it will be a difficult game, and they fought very hard. ‘At one point, it went very fast from side to side. Sometimes we had control and, of course, in certain moments when you go higher up the pitch they will be very aggressive and the way they play is very difficult. ‘In the second half they dropped very low and had every man behind the ball, so we had a bit more control and we had to push. We had some chances, but it was difficult against 11 behind the ball to find the right spaces. We kept pushing, especially in the last 15 minutes, we kept dropping balls at them, but it wasn’t enough.’ With domestic action pausing for the international break, there is now a brief window to reset before we host Leeds on 21 November. For Penders, the key now is maintaining collective belief and building on the positive elements of recent performances ahead of our return to action later this month. ‘If you watch some of the last games, we played pretty well,’ said Penders. ‘The structure is getting better and it’s a pity that we have lost this game. ‘It’s a matter of staying together. I think we’ve had some good games, but after losing these games, we have to stick together. It’s the international break now, so we can calm our heads, and when we come back we need to all be motivated and go again.’
news.body_zh: 周日输给桑德兰后，迈克·彭德斯并没有掩饰切尔西更衣室里的失望和沮丧。光明球场上一场激烈的比赛因恩佐·勒费上半场的点球而决定胜负。蓝军拥有充足的控球权和地盘，尤其是在中场休息后，但无法在面对坚决的黑猫后卫时创造明显的机会。除了在第二节中扑出威尔逊·伊西多的一次出色扑救之外，彭德斯也没有太多事情要做。但伤害已经造成，一个进球足以帮助桑德兰赢得本赛季的第二场联赛胜利。 “对结果非常失望，”彭德斯说。 “你知道，当你来到他们的体育场时，这将是一场艰难的比赛，他们打得非常努力。 “有一次，它从一端移动到另一端速度非常快。有时我们有控制权，当然，在某些时刻，当你往前走的时候，他们会非常有侵略性，他们的比赛方式也非常困难。 “下半场他们的位置很低，每个人都在球后面，所以我们有更多的控制权，我们必须推动。我们有过一些机会，但面对 11 名后卫，我们很难找到合适的空间。我们一直在努力，特别是在最后 15 分钟，我们不断向他们扔球，但这还不够。”随着国际比赛日暂停国内比赛，在我们 11 月 21 日主场迎战利兹联之前，现在有一个短暂的重置窗口。对于彭德斯来说，现在的关键是保持集体信念，并在本月晚些时候恢复行动之前以近期表现的积极因素为基础。 “如果你看了最近的一些比赛，你会发现我们踢得很好，”彭德斯说。 ‘结构正在变得更好，遗憾的是我们输掉了这场比赛。 ‘这是一个待在一起的问题。我认为我们打出了一些精彩的比赛，但在输掉这些比赛之后，我们必须团结起来。现在是国际比赛日，所以我们可以冷静下来，当我们回来时，我们需要充满动力并再次出发。”

news.title: Alonso: We didn’t produce enough to deserve to win
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：我们的表现不足以赢得胜利
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso felt the Blues could have come away from Sunderland with a point with a bit more luck, but accepted we didn’t do enough to deserve more than that. We succumbed to a narrow 1-0 defeat at the Stadium of Light in a game ultimately decided by one first-half refereeing decision, which saw the home side awarded a first-half penalty that Enzo Le Fee converted. The Blues pushed hard for an equaliser to salvage a point in the second period, especially during the closing stages, when substitutes Geovany Quenda and Danny Welbeck both went close. However, Alonso was in no mood to make excuses after the final whistle, admitting his side hadn’t performed at the level he expects, particularly when it came to our attempts to break down the stubborn Sunderland defence after falling behind. ‘I would say there were situations that we could have defended better, situations that we could have got better advantages in attack, but the game was really even, really competitive,’ said our manager. ‘They were waiting for the chance – and they got it. After they took the lead, we were trying, but we were not producing much. The first goal is always important and today, when we were behind, we didn't produce enough. ‘It wasn't the best game. I think that we didn't deserve more than probably one point. The game was really close. ‘Not much happened, to be honest, just that action [for the Sunderland penalty]. We had the cross in the first half, the header from Morgan (Rogers), but we didn't produce enough to deserve to win. ‘We were against a low block. We missed a bit of patience and a bit of quality, creativity in the last third to create more chances. You need to be more consistent to move the ball from one side to the other, and we didn't do good enough.’ Alonso conceded that the absences of unavailable players could have influenced our performance, as Josh Acheampong was ruled out with a small issue on Saturday and the game was too soon for Emiliano Martinez to make his return. Jorrel Hato, Jamie Gittens, Reece James, Maxence Lacroix and Joao Pedro also remain out. The Blues will now go into the international break hoping to get at least some of those players back for our next game against Leeds United on 21 November, even if Alonso made clear he expects better from the Blues, whoever is in the team. ‘There are situations,' he acknowledged. 'Yesterday Josh felt something and he was not fit to play. So we are shorter in options and we need to go through this time. ‘Even when we win, or when we lose, we miss some players that we have injured and for sure we are waiting to have them back because they are important. Now we need to use the time to recover them, but with the players we have, we have to get ready for the next one.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索认为，如果运气好的话，蓝军本可以从桑德兰带走一分，但他承认我们做得还不够，值得得到更多。我们在光明球场以 1-0 险胜，这场比赛最终是由上半场裁判的决定决定的，主队判给了上半场的点球，恩佐·勒费将球罚进。蓝军在第二节奋力扳平比分，尤其是在最后阶段，替补出场的乔瓦尼·昆达和丹尼·维尔贝克都险些扳平比分。然而，终场哨响后，阿隆索没有心情找借口，承认他的球队没有达到他预期的水平，特别是当我们在落后的情况下试图打破桑德兰顽强的防守时。 “我想说，在某些情况下我们本可以防守得更好，在某些情况下我们本可以在进攻中获得更好的优势，但比赛真的很均匀，很有竞争力，”我们的主教练说。 “他们在等待机会——而且他们得到了机会。”他们取得领先后，我们也在尝试，但成果并不多。第一个进球总是很重要，而今天，当我们落后时，我们的表现还不够。 ‘这不是最好的比赛。我认为我们只配得到一分。这场比赛非常接近。 “说实话，并没有发生什么事情，只是（对桑德兰的点球）那个动作。上半场我们接到了传中，摩根（罗杰斯）的头球攻门，但我们的表现不足以赢得胜利。 “我们反对低位。我们在最后三分之一失去了一点耐心、一点质量和创造力来创造更多机会。你需要更加稳定地将球从一侧转移到另一侧，而我们做得还不够好。”阿隆索承认，缺席的球员可能会影响我们的表现，因为乔什·阿奇姆蓬在周六因一个小问题而被排除在外，而这场比赛对于埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯来说还为时过早。乔雷尔·哈托 (Jorrel Hato)、杰米·吉滕斯 (Jamie Gittens)、里斯·詹姆斯 (Reece James)、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 和若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 也没有参加。蓝军现在将进入国际比赛日，希望至少能找回其中一些球员参加 11 月 21 日对阵利兹联的下一场比赛，即使阿隆索明确表示他对蓝军有更好的期望，无论队中是谁。 “有些情况，”他承认。 “昨天约什感觉到了一些东西，他不适合参加比赛。所以我们的选择比较少，我们需要经历这一次。 “即使我们赢了，或者输了，我们也会想念一些受伤的球员，我们肯定会等待他们回来，因为他们很重要。现在我们需要利用时间来恢复他们，但凭借我们现有的球员，我们必须为下一场比赛做好准备。”

news.title: Match report: Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：桑德兰 1-0 切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea fell to a narrow defeat at the Stadium of Light on Sunday as a first-half penalty secured Sunderland the points. We could easily have had a spot-kick of our own before Enzo Le Fee netted the only goal, with a foul on Cole Palmer adjudged to have taken place just outside the box. The margins were fine in a scrappy contest, and another decision went the home side’s way after Brian Brobbey and Levi Colwill came together in the box. Le Fee converted. Having led at half-time for the first time this season, Sunderland defended their advantage doggedly. We struggled to fashion clear chances, with the best headed over by sub Danny Welbeck in stoppage time. Xabi Alonso made a pair of changes to the team that started against Manchester United last weekend. Pep Chavarria came in for Josh Acheampong, who missed out entirely with what Alonso said was a ‘minor issue’. Further forward, Jordan Henderson returned at the club where he came through, with Estevao Willian making way. Henderson played as the most advanced of a midfield trio also containing Moises Caicedo and Romeo Lavia. Mike Penders continued in goal, with Emiliano Martinez deemed not quite ready to start after his jaw surgery. There was also a place on the bench for Aaron Anselmino for the first time this season. After an immaculately observed period of silence to mark Remembrance Sunday, play got underway with Chelsea defending the goal high behind which the 3,000-strong travelling support were housed. Our hosts were dealt an early blow when Granit Xhaka had to be withdrawn inside four minutes. A scrappy start was punctured by a good chance for Brobbey, who volleyed Chemsdine Talbi’s teasing cross wide from close range. Midway through the half, Palmer was chopped down by Luke O’Nien as he advanced into the box. The referee didn’t give a foul, but replays showed it clearly was one. The only question was whether it took place inside the box. It was a very tight call, and one that unfortunately didn’t go in our favour. We very nearly let out our frustrations at that decision by immediately taking the lead. An inviting cross by Palestra from the right flank was met by the rising Rogers, who couldn’t steer his header on target. Brobbey was proving a nuisance. He led a breakaway from Colwill inside his own half but Fofana did well to take him wide. When the shot arrived, it flew over the bar. However, there was no such reprieve on 35 minutes. Brobbey spun Colwill and having got the wrong side of our defender, went to ground. There wasn’t a lot in it, with both players having a hold of the other’s shirt, but the referee’s on-call decision of penalty stood. Le Fee sent Penders the wrong way from 12 yards. It stayed 1-0 until half-time and Alonso responded by bringing on Estevao for Colwill. Caicedo dropped back into central defence, and we now had another attacker on the pitch. With the Blues still finding time and space in the final third at a premium, Alonso made two more changes on the hour. Welbeck and Malo Gusto replaced Neto and Palestra, with the Frenchman making his 100th Premier League appearance. There were a couple of nearly moments for first Estevao and then Palmer as a pair of penetrative passes from Rogers prized the Sunderland backline open. With 15 to play, it needed a brave and big save from Penders to deny Wilson Isidor – not long on for Brobbey – after a loose ball fell to him six yards out. Geovany Quenda nearly scored with his first involvement, a left-footed strike that took a deflection and had Robin Roefs scrambling across his goal. There was plenty of late possession and territory for the Blues, and the chance to equalise came from the head of Welbeck in stoppage time. Unfortunately, his effort flew over the bar, and with it went our hopes of returning to London with something to show for our efforts. We go into the final international break of the season in fifth place in the Premier League table. The Blues host Leeds United on Saturday 21 November following the pause for international football. news.body_zh: 周日，切尔西在光明球场以微弱优势落败，桑德兰凭借上半场的点球锁定了积分。在恩佐·勒费攻入唯一进球之前，我们本可以轻松获得一个点球，因为科尔·帕尔默在禁区外犯规。在一场激烈的比赛中，比分还算不错，而在布莱恩·布罗比和利维·科尔威尔在禁区内齐心协力后，主队又做出了另一个决定。勒费皈依了。桑德兰本赛季首次在半场领先，但他们顽强地捍卫了自己的优势。我们努力创造明确的机会，补时阶段替补丹尼·维尔贝克头球破门。哈维·阿隆索对上周末对阵曼联的首发阵容做出了一些调整。佩普·查瓦里亚（Pep Chavarria）替换了乔什·阿奇姆蓬（Josh Acheampong），后者因阿隆索所说的“小问题”而完全错过了比赛。再往前走，乔丹·亨德森回到了他出身的俱乐部，埃斯特沃·威廉让位。亨德森是莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和罗密欧·拉维亚中场三人组中最先进的球员。迈克·彭德斯继续守门，埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯在下巴手术后被认为尚未准备好首发。亚伦·安塞尔米诺（Aaron Anselmino）本赛季首次在替补席上占有一席之地。在周日的阵亡将士纪念日默哀一段时间后，比赛开始了，切尔西队防守着球门，球门后有 3,000 名客场支援。当格兰尼特·扎卡（Granit Xhaka）不得不在四分钟内撤回时，我们的东道主很快就受到了打击。布罗比（Brobbey）的一次好机会打破了开局不利的局面，他近距离将切姆斯丁·塔尔比（Chemsdine Talbi）的挑衅传中凌空抽射偏出。半场中段，帕尔默突入禁区时被卢克·奥尼恩砍倒。裁判没有判犯规，但回放显示这显然是犯规。唯一的问题是它是否发生在盒子里。这是一个非常紧迫的决定，不幸的是，这个决定对我们不利。我们几乎立即带头发泄了对这一决定的不满。帕莱斯特拉从右翼传中，罗杰斯接住了起身的罗杰斯，但他的头球未能击中目标。事实证明，布罗比很讨厌。他在本方半场内突破科尔威尔，但福法纳出色地将他带出边路。当射门到来时，它飞过了横梁。然而，35分钟后并没有出现这样的缓刑。布罗比（Brobbey）旋转了科尔威尔（Colwill），并在我们的防守者的错误一侧，倒地。虽然事情并不多，两名球员都抓住了对方的球衣，但裁判的点球决定仍然有效。勒费从 12 码处将彭德斯送出错误的方向。直到半场结束，比分一直保持在1-0，阿隆索做出回应，为科尔威尔换下埃斯特沃。凯塞多回撤到中卫，现在我们场上又多了一名攻击手。由于蓝军仍然在进攻三分之一中寻找宝贵的时间和空间，阿隆索在这一小时内又做出了两次改变。维尔贝克和马洛·古斯托取代了内托和帕莱斯特拉，这是法国人第100次在英超联赛中出场。埃斯特沃（Estevao）和帕尔默（Palmer）都有几次险些进球的机会，罗杰斯（Rogers）的两次渗透性传球打开了桑德兰的后防线。比赛还剩 15 场，潘德斯在 6 码外接到一个松散的球落在威尔逊·伊西多 (Wilson Isidor) 身上后，他需要勇敢而大力的扑救才将球挡出——布罗比 (Brobbey) 很快就扑出了他的球。乔瓦尼·昆达（Geovany Quenda）第一次出场就差点进球，他的左脚射门发生偏转，罗宾·罗夫斯（Robin Roefs）争先恐后地冲过球门。蓝军在最后时刻拥有充足的控球权和地盘，扳平比分的机会来自维尔贝克在伤停补时阶段的头球。不幸的是，他的努力飞过了标准，我们带着一些东西来展示我们的努力的希望也随之消失了。我们以英超积分榜第五名的成绩进入本赛季最后的国际比赛日。 11 月 21 日星期六，国际足球比赛暂停后，蓝军将主场迎战利兹联队。 切尔西（4-3-3）：彭德斯； Palestra (Gusto 62)、Fofana、Colwill (Estevao h/t)、Chavarria (Quenda 79)；拉维亚、凯塞多 (c)、亨德森 (Emegha 87)；帕尔默、内托（维尔贝克 62）、罗杰斯 未上场替补：沙曼-洛、安塞尔米诺、巴科、尼科尔-贾祖利 黄牌 科尔威尔 35、内托 55、凯塞多 76 桑德兰（4-2-3-1）：罗夫斯；穆尼耶、穆基勒、奥内因、雷尼尔多；萨迪基、扎卡 (c) (Ahoka 4)；休姆、勒费 (Rigg 88)、塔尔比 (Angulo 88)；布罗比 (Isidor 67) 未上场替补：埃尔博格、丹索、梅塔莉、福法纳、图铁洛夫。得分手勒费 36 黄牌 阿霍卡 21、莫尼耶 50、布罗比 53、奥尼恩 90、安古洛 90+4

news.title: Premier League 2 report: Tottenham Hotspur 1-3 Chelsea Cobham Next Gen
news.title_zh: 英超联赛 2 报告：托特纳姆热刺 1-3 切尔西科巴姆下一代
news.body_en: Chelsea Cobham Next Gen leapfrogged Tottenham Hotspur into second in the Premier League 2 table after a Harrison McMahon goal and a brace from Chizaram Ezenwata sealed a 3-1 win. It didn’t take the Blues long to take the lead, with McMahon scoring his second goal in as many matches by rounding goalkeeper Samual Archer and finishing after being put through one-on-one by Reggie Watson. Ezenwata doubled our advantage before the interval with his seventh goal of the season across all competitions for the Blues. We defended well for much of the second period, but Spurs pulled a goal back with 14 minutes to play when James Rowswell found the net. Despite late pressure from the hosts, we made sure of all three points when Ezenwata struck his second in stoppage time to seal victory. We exploited Tottenham’s high backline from the off, and Sol Gordon had an opportunity inside five minutes. A good ball forward from Calvin Diakite put the Blues winger through, but Archer saved well to turn the ball behind for a corner. It proved only a momentary reprieve for the home side as we soon broke the deadlock. Watson played a long ball over the top to McMahon, who remained composed to take the ball around the goalkeeper and slot home. We continued to probe the Tottenham defence across the remainder of the opening 45 minutes, although the hosts had chances of their own and Freddy Bernal produced a couple of smart stops in the Chelsea goal. Shortly before the interval, Gordon again came close. The Blues winger beat the Spurs' offside trap, raced into the box and aimed a shot toward the far post. Gordon's attempt beat Archer but was cleared off the line, and while Leo Cardoso was there for the follow-up, he was also denied. Three minutes before the interval, however, our second arrived. It was somewhat straightforward as Bernal hit a long pass into the Tottenham half and Ezenwata manoeuvred his way beyond the last defender and confidently finished beyond Archer. After the break, we kept pushing and came close to extending our advantage from corners, with Olutayo Subuloye asserting his dominance in the penalty area. Corners from Watson found the head of Subuloye repeatedly, with the Blues skipper consistently overpowering his marker, but he couldn't divert his attempts on target. Ezenwata also came close, utilising his excellent hold-up play to manufacture an opportunity. The Chelsea striker had his back to goal when he received possession, but created half a yard to get his shot off. Unfortunately, it curled too late and went just wide of the far post. Tottenham’s skipper, Roswell, halved the deficit from a set piece with 76 minutes left on the clock. Yet it was the Blues who had the final say in this derby. As the game entered additional time, Tottenham earned a free kick which they opted to take quickly. Substitute Harrison Bettoni reacted quickest to intercept the ball and get a shot away. His attempt was too powerful for Archer, who palmed the ball back out to Ezenwata. The Blues striker made no mistake and thumped a shot into the back of the net to put the game to bed and ensure all three points returned to Cobham. Our 3-1 win on derby day means that we are up to 16 points in PL2 after seven matches. We have leapfrogged Spurs and now sit in second position. Cobham Next Gen are back in PL2 action on Friday 27 November following the international break, when we face Norwich City at the Avant Training Centre. The game gets underway at 7pm GMT and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 哈里森·麦克马洪 (Harrison McMahon) 的进球和奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔 (Chizaram Ezenwata) 的梅开二度帮助切尔西 3-1 获胜，科巴姆下一代 (Chelsea Cobham Next Gen) 超越托特纳姆热刺 (Tottenham Hotspur)，跃居英超第二。没过多久，蓝军就取得了领先，麦克马洪绕过门将萨缪尔·阿切尔，并在一对一的雷吉·沃森的防守下完成射门，打进了他在多场比赛中的第二个进球。埃森瓦塔在中场休息前打进了蓝军本赛季所有比赛的第七个进球，将我们的优势扩大了一倍。我们在第二节的大部分时间里防守得很好，但在比赛还剩 14 分钟时，詹姆斯·罗斯韦尔 (James Rowswell) 进球，热刺扳回一球。尽管主队最后时刻施压，但我们还是确保了全取三分，因为江泽渡在伤停补时阶段打进第二球锁定了胜利。我们从一开始就利用了热刺的高后防线，索尔·戈登在五分钟内就获得了机会。卡尔文·迪亚基特（Calvin Diakite）向前传球，让蓝军边锋破门，但阿切尔（Archer）出色扑救，将球转入角球。事实证明，这只是主队暂时的喘息之机，我们很快就打破了僵局。沃森向麦克马洪传出一记长传球，麦克马洪仍然保持镇定，将球绕过门将射入球门。我们在开场 45 分钟的剩余时间里继续探究托特纳姆热刺的防守，尽管主队有自己的机会，而且弗雷迪·伯纳尔在切尔西的球门中做出了几次漂亮的扑救。中场休息前不久，戈登再次接近。蓝军边锋突破了热刺的越位陷阱，冲入禁区，射向远门柱。戈登的尝试击败了阿切尔，但被清除出线，而当里奥·卡多佐在场时，他也被挡出。然而，中场休息前三分钟，我们的第二场比赛到来了。这有点简单，伯纳尔长传到托特纳姆热刺半场，埃森瓦塔突破了最后一名后卫，自信地超越了阿切尔。中场休息后，我们继续推进，差点扩大角球优势，奥卢塔约·苏布洛耶在禁区内确立了统治地位。沃森的角球多次击中苏布洛耶的头球，这位蓝军队长始终压制住了盯防他的球员，但他无法转移射门的机会。 Ezenwata 也很接近，利用他出色的防守创造了机会。切尔西前锋在接到球权时背对球门，但创造了半码射门机会。不幸的是，球弧线太晚了，稍稍偏出了远门柱。托特纳姆热刺队队长罗斯威尔在比赛还剩 76 分钟时通过定位球将比分差距缩小了一半。然而，蓝军在这场德比战中拥有最终决定权。比赛进入加时赛，托特纳姆热刺获得了一个任意球，但他们很快就主罚了。替补球员哈里森·贝托尼反应最快，拦截球并射门。他的射门对阿切尔来说太有力了，阿切尔将球传回给埃森瓦塔。蓝军前锋没有犯错，一脚劲射入网，结束了比赛，确保科巴姆全取三分。我们在德比日以 3-1 获胜意味着我们在 7 场比赛后在 PL2 中的积分上升到了 16 分。我们已经超越了热刺，现在排名第二。科巴姆下一代队将于 11 月 27 日星期五国际比赛日结束后重返 PL2 比赛，届时我们将在 Avant 训练中心对阵诺维奇城。比赛于格林威治标准时间晚上 7 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（3-4-3）：弗雷迪·伯纳尔；奥卢塔约·苏布洛耶、贾斯汀·奥萨吉、卡尔文·迪亚基特；利奥·布莱克、雷吉·沃森、哈里森·麦克马洪、肯德利·佩兹（易卜拉欣·拉巴杰 77）； Leo Cardoso (Harrison Bettoni 72), Chizaram Ezenwata, Sol Gordon 未使用的替补：托比·贝尔，丹特·韦特，阿尔菲·奥斯本，查理·科尔科特，Trialist记分员：麦克马洪 7, Ezenwata 42, 90+1黄牌：Paez 32, Osagie 38, Black 78 托特纳姆热刺 (4-3-3)：Samual Archer；詹姆斯·罗斯韦尔（中）、梅森·金、俊艾·拜菲尔德（乔治·菲尼 67）、阿尔菲·多林顿；哈利·伯恩、泰伊·霍尔、卡勒姆·奥卢塞西（麦克斯·麦克法登 67）； Elisha Sowunmi (Ellis Lehane 67)、Tyrese Hall、Reiss Elliott-Parris (Cole Ramsey 72) 未上场替补：Farren Doran、Ronnie Moncur、Maxwell Adedeji 得分：Rowswell 76黄牌：Dorrington 64、Elliott-Parris 65、King 70、Hall 90+4

news.title: Alonso explains Acheampong and Martinez absences against Sunderland
news.title_zh: 阿隆索解释阿奇姆蓬和马丁内斯缺席对阵桑德兰的比赛
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has explained why Josh Acheampong and Emi Martinez are not in the Chelsea squad for today's game against Sunderland, which the Blues manager says will be a tough and intense contest. Our final fixture before the November international break takes us to the Stadium of Light, where we will face a Sunderland side that has won one of their opening nine top-flight matches. The Blues' last outing was a 2-0 victory over Manchester United at Stamford Bridge. Alonso has made two changes to the side that started that win, with Pep Chavarria replacing Acheampong in defence and Jordan Henderson coming in for Estevao Willian. Alonso was asked ahead of this afternoon's contest why Acheampong wasn't included in the matchday squad. He replied: ‘He is recovering from a minor thing. 'He missed the fitness to be ready for today but we are expecting that he will be back after the international break. It’s a pity because he was in a good moment.’ Martinez hasn't featured for the Blues since our win at Everton last month. The Argentine goalkeeper had to undergo jaw surgery following the victory due to a collision with Jarrad Branthwaite. The 34-year-old returned to training this week wearing protective headgear but wasn't quite ready to take his place in the squad. Alonso said: ‘He has made a great effort to be available but probably it was too rash, too risky [to be selected]. So he will use one more week, ten days, to keep on training and get used to the mask. I’m sure after the break he will be available.’ Henderson's return to the Blues' starting XI comes in the city he was born in – and against the club he started his career with. Alonso is confident the England international will once again bring plenty to our midfield against a tough opponent. He added: ‘No, I remember his start here in Sunderland, it’s not that he plays because he was born here, it’s because he is so important for the team and is doing really well. I’m sure he is going to help today. ‘All the games in the Premier League are tough, we know that even when you play well you maybe don’t get what you deserve, but this is the reality of the Premier League. For sure it’s going to be a tough game for both sides, intense, but we feel ready and hopefully we can finish with a good win before the internationals.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索解释了为什么乔什·阿奇姆蓬和埃米·马丁内斯没有出现在切尔西今天对阵桑德兰的比赛阵容中，蓝军主帅表示这将是一场艰难而激烈的比赛。 11 月国际比赛日之前的最后一场比赛将前往光明球场，在那里我们将对阵桑德兰队，他们在前九场顶级联赛中赢了一场。蓝军上一场比赛是在斯坦福桥2-0战胜曼联。阿隆索对这场胜利的首发阵容做出了两次调整，佩普·查瓦里亚(Pep Chavarria)取代了阿切姆蓬(Acheampong)担任后防线，乔丹·亨德森(Jordan Henderson)替换了埃斯特沃·威廉(Estevao Willian)。在今天下午的比赛前，阿隆索被问到为什么阿奇姆蓬没有被列入比赛日阵容。他回答说：“他正在从一件小事中恢复过来。” “他错过了今天的训练，但我们预计他会在国际比赛日后回归。很遗憾，因为他正处于一个很好的时刻。自从上个月我们战胜埃弗顿以来，马丁内斯就没有为蓝军出场过。获胜后，阿根廷门将因与贾拉德·布兰斯维特相撞而不得不接受下颌手术。这位 34 岁的球员本周戴着防护帽重返训练，但还没有准备好在球队中占据一席之地。阿隆索说：“他为上场做出了很大的努力，但[被选中]可能太草率、太冒险了。”所以他会再用一周、十天的时间继续训练，适应面具。我确信在休息后他就能上场。”亨德森重返蓝军首发阵容是在他出生的城市——对阵他职业生涯开始的俱乐部。阿隆索相信这位英格兰国脚将再次为我们的中场带来强大的力量来对抗强敌。他补充道：“不，我记得他在桑德兰开始踢球，并不是因为他出生在这里，而是因为他对球队非常重要，而且表现非常好。”我确信他今天会帮忙。 “英超联赛的所有比赛都很艰难，我们知道，即使你踢得很好，你也可能得不到你应得的，但这就是英超联赛的现实。毫无疑问，这对双方来说都将是一场艰难的比赛，非常激烈，但我们已经做好了准备，希望我们能够在国际比赛之前取得一场精彩的胜利。

news.title: Why Xabi Alonso wants 'busy weeks' in his Chelsea future
news.title_zh: 为什么哈维·阿隆索希望在切尔西的未来有“忙碌的几周”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso and his Chelsea players have had seven days to prepare for today's trip to Sunderland. However, the Blues manager does not want that luxury next season. With no European football on our agenda this term, Alonso has enjoyed more quality time with his squad on the training pitches at Cobham during the opening months of his tenure. That has been important for the Spaniard, who is still embedding his tactical principles and forging close bonds with his players. He has overseen a largely positive start to the campaign, with the Blues fourth in the top flight having taken 16 points from our opening nine fixtures. Our tenth takes place this afternoon as we travel to Sunderland, who, in contrast to the Blues, are competing in European football for the first time in more than 50 years. That comes with its own pressures and a more punishing schedule. Yet it's one Alonso wants  – and one he insists he and his players are working toward. 'The ambition is to be back there [in Europe],' the Blues manager explained during his pre-match press conference. '[We want it] to be just one season that we are having long weeks. The aim, the desire, the hunger is to have busy weeks, to have to deal with three games a week, and that we'll see each other much more. 'It's not that it hurts now, because you deal with it, but this is where we want to be.' As a two-time Champions League winner and someone who made 119 appearances in the competition during his playing career, Alonso is well-versed in the demands that come with performing at the top table of European football. He wants Chelsea to be back on that stage, but appreciates that only comes through hard work and consistency in the months ahead. 'We want to be playing in Europe, in big stadiums, having top teams in Europe because I think that we can be there, but we need to earn it to be there. 'We like football and, unfortunately, we can only comment [on what has taken place during a European gameweek]. The feeling is that we want to be there, but we need to deserve that.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索和他的切尔西球员有 7 天的时间为今天对阵桑德兰的比赛做准备。然而，蓝军主帅下赛季并不想要这种奢侈。由于本学期没有欧洲足球比赛，阿隆索在上任的头几个月里与他的球队在科巴姆的训练场上享受了更多的优质时光。这对于西班牙人来说非常重要，他仍然坚持自己的战术原则并与球员建立密切的联系。在他的带领下，蓝军在本赛季取得了良好的开局，在顶级联赛中排名第四，在前九场比赛中拿下了 16 分。我们的第十场比赛将于今天下午前往桑德兰举行，与蓝军不同，桑德兰是 50 多年来首次参加欧洲足球比赛。这也带来了自身的压力和更加严峻的赛程安排。但这正是阿隆索想要的——而且他坚称他和他的球员正在为之努力。 “我们的目标是回到欧洲，”蓝军主帅在赛前新闻发布会上解释道。 “[我们希望]这只是我们度过漫长几周的一个赛季。我们的目标、愿望和渴望是度过忙碌的几周，每周应对三场比赛，并且我们会更多地见面。 “现在并不痛苦，因为你要应对它，但这就是我们想要的地方。”作为两届欧洲冠军联赛冠军以及在职业生涯中出场 119 次的阿隆索，深知在欧洲足球顶级联赛中表现的要求。他希望切尔西能够重返那个舞台，但他很感激这只能通过未来几个月的努力和坚持来实现。 “我们希望在欧洲的大型体育场踢球，拥有欧洲顶级球队，因为我认为我们可以到达那里，但我们需要赢得它才能到达那里。 “我们喜欢足球，不幸的是，我们只能评论[欧洲比赛周期间发生的事情]。感觉是我们想要在那里，但我们需要配得上它。

news.title: Opposition scout – Sunderland
news.title_zh: 反对派球探 – 桑德兰
news.body_en: Ahead of Chelsea's Premier League meeting with Sunderland, we take a closer look at the Black Cats, their approach under Regis Le Bris and the players who could make an impact. The Black Cats are 12 points shy of last season’s tally at the same stage, having scored four fewer goals and conceded ten more. While many of their metrics are comparable to last season, Regis Le Bris’s team have been affected by individual errors, with three of their players having made mistakes that twice led to goals. Le Bris, who joined the Wearsiders from French club Lorient in 2024, has maintained a consistent line-up from last season despite plenty of investment over recent transfer windows. Nine of Sunderland’s starters in the 3-0 loss to Coventry last weekend began the match in May at Stamford Bridge that clinched their first European foray since 1973 at Chelsea’s expense. The Frenchman has handled Sunderland’s busy schedule by making substantial changes in cup games at home and abroad. The workload may also explain a more measured approach to high pressing – they have not scored from a high turnover this season. The manager will be forced into at least one change in central defence, as Luke O’Nien’s partner Omar Alderete is suspended after receiving a second yellow card in the last minute at Coventry. Le Bris has stuck with the midfield pivot of Granit Xhaka, now 34, and Noah Sadiki, and often prefers full-backs such as Trai Hume or Thomas Meunier on the wings over the likes of summer signings Jocelin Ta Bi and Malick Fofana. Lone striker and leading marksman Brian Brobbey has accounted for three of Sunderland’s seven league goals, one ahead of No.10 Enzo Le Fee. Centre-back Dan Ballard, midfielder Habib Diarra and winger Romaine Mundle are injured, but left-back Nordi Mukiele and teenage striker Juan Riquelme Angulo could return to readiness.
news.body_zh: 在切尔西对阵桑德兰的英超联赛之前，我们仔细研究了黑猫队、他们在雷吉斯·勒布里斯的带领下的表现以及可能产生影响的球员。黑猫队比上赛季同期得分低 12 分，进球数减少 4 个，失球数增加 10 个。虽然他们的许多指标与上赛季相当，但雷吉斯·勒布里斯的球队受到了个人错误的影响，他们的三名球员曾两次犯下导致进球的错误。勒布里斯于 2024 年从法国洛里昂俱乐部加盟韦赛德，尽管在最近的转会窗口进行了大量投资，但他仍保持了上赛季的阵容稳定。上周末 0-3 输给考文垂的比赛中，桑德兰队的 9 名首发球员于 5 月份在斯坦福桥开始了比赛，这场比赛是他们自 1973 年以来首次进军欧洲赛场，但切尔西队却被淘汰。这位法国人通过对国内外杯赛做出了重大改变来应对桑德兰繁忙的赛程。工作量也可能解释了他们在高位逼抢时采取了更加谨慎的态度——本赛季他们并没有从高失误中得分。主教练将被迫至少对中卫进行一次调整，卢克·奥尼恩的搭档奥马尔·阿尔德雷特在对阵考文垂的最后一分钟吃到第二张黄牌后停赛。勒布里斯一直坚持以现年34岁的格拉尼特·扎卡和诺阿·萨迪基为中场核心，并且经常更喜欢边后卫，如特拉伊·休姆或托马斯·穆尼耶，而不是夏季签约的乔赛林·塔比和马利克·福法纳等边后卫。桑德兰队的七个联赛进球中，单前锋和射手布莱恩·布罗比打进了三个进球，领先于排名第十的恩佐·勒费。中后卫丹·巴拉德、中场球员哈比卜·迪亚拉和边锋罗曼·蒙德尔受伤，但左后卫诺迪·穆基勒和青少年前锋胡安·里克尔梅·安古洛可能会恢复状态。

news.title_zh: OTD：吉安弗兰科·佐拉加盟切尔西 - 观看他的所有进球！
news.body_en: It was on this day in 1996, precisely 30 years ago now, that the Blues completed the signing of Gianfranco Zola, who over seven seasons at Stamford Bridge stole the hearts of Chelsea fans everywhere. He helped win four trophies and scored the winner in the 1998 European Cup Winners' Cup final just seconds after coming on as substitute. In all, Franco scored 80 goals in 312 games, with many of them being spectacular efforts. You can watch the lot below!Goals that will live long in the memory include a mid-air back-flick against Norwich City, an effort against Manchester United that left opposition goalkeeper Peter Schmeichel motionless and a brilliant turn and shot in a 1997 FA Cup semi-final win over Wimbledon. Above all, Franco always played football as if he enjoyed it and was almost universally popular amongst opposition fans.Zola did suffer a dip in form during the 2001/02 season but returned strongly the following season, scoring 16 times as we qualified for the Champions League. He scored his last goal for Chelsea on Easter Monday 2003 and in his final appearance came on for the last 20 minutes of a win over Liverpool that saw us claim fourth place and with it, Champions League qualification. It was a truly fitting finale to a glorious Chelsea career.
news.body_zh: 正是在 1996 年的今天，也就是 30 年前，蓝军完成了对詹弗兰科·佐拉的签约，他在斯坦福桥度过了七个多赛季，俘获了各地切尔西球迷的心。他帮助赢得了四座奖杯，并在 1998 年欧洲优胜者杯决赛中替补上场数秒后攻入制胜球。弗朗哥总共在 312 场比赛中打进了 80 个进球，其中许多进球都是令人惊叹的。您可以在下面观看很多精彩进球！这些进球将长久地留在人们的记忆中，包括对阵诺维奇城的空中后弹、对阵曼联的一脚射门，让对手门将彼得·舒梅切尔一动不动，以及 1997 年足总杯半决赛战胜温布尔登的精彩转身射门。最重要的是，佛朗哥踢球时总是表现得好像他很享受足球一样，并且几乎受到了对手球迷的普遍欢迎。佐拉在2001/02赛季的状态确实有所下滑，但在接下来的赛季强势回归，攻入16球，帮助我们获得了欧冠资格。 2003 年复活节星期一，他为切尔西打入最后一个进球，并在最后 20 分钟出场，帮助切尔西战胜利物浦，帮助我们获得第四名并获得欧冠资格。这是辉煌的切尔西职业生涯真正恰当的结局。

news.title: Gianfranco Zola’s greatest moments in Blue
news.title_zh: 詹弗兰科·佐拉在蓝色时期最伟大的时刻
news.body_en: Gianfranco Zola is, quite simply, one of Chelsea’s very best. On the 30th anniversary of his signing, what better time to relive Zola’s glorious career in west London. The Italian magician arrived from Parma on 8 November 1996 and left nearly seven years later as an all-time great, his place in our history books cemented by a catalogue of indelible moments. Narrowing them down to a shortlist is no easy feat – anybody who had the good fortune of watching Zola play for us will call to mind different memories of his genius. But here are 11 moments, in chronological order, that we think stand out above the rest... Zola’s first Chelsea goal was a sign of things to come. Standing over a free-kick 35 yards out, few would have given him a chance of finding the net – but we didn’t know then quite how capable he was from set-pieces. His strike had whip and dip, leaving Everton’s keeper Neville Southall and a defender who had hastily retreated to the line in a spin, and Chelsea mouths agape. A fortnight later Zola’s ingenuity again left Stamford Bridge in awe. This time he was released down the right-hand channel before turning grizzled West Ham full-back Julian Dicks inside and out and firing home with aplomb. 'I didn't know who Julian Dicks was at that point,' Gianfranco joked years later. 'Probably if I had known maybe I wouldn't have done that as it was too dangerous!' Few made the great Manchester United team of the nineties and noughties look as silly as Zola did in just the second minute of a February ’97 Premier League meeting. He first cut inside the sliding Dennis Irwin before easing past Gary Pallister, left imbalanced by Zola’s delicate touch. The finish that followed was emphatic, fired past the rooted Peter Schmeichel at his near post. Not even six months into his Chelsea career and Zola had already accumulated an enviable collection of wonder goals. Arguably none topped his dazzling effort in the FA Cup semi-final win over Wimbledon at Highbury. Running adjacent to the goal, Zola collected a pass from Roberto Di Matteo and with his first touch somehow flicked it back in the opposite direction and into his path as he shifted his weight. One more touch and then bang – the ball was in the Wimbledon net! Zola’s debut season in England captured the attention of fans and pundits alike, to the extent the country’s journalists voted him as their Football Writers’ Association Footballer of the Year by a distance – Zola polled twice the number of votes gained by Juninho and our own Mark Hughes. It was a season in which he also scored the winning goal for Italy against England at Wembley. Our first piece of major silverware in a generation was secured when Eddie Newton forced the ball home from close range late on in our FA Cup final triumph against Middlesbrough at Wembley. The goal owed much to the majesty of Zola, who deftly flicked Dan Petrescu’s cross back into the six-yard box for Newton to convert. Zola’s most famous Chelsea goal arrived scarcely 20 seconds after he had entered the action in the 1998 Cup Winners’ Cup final. He wasted no time making an impact, latching on a Dennis Wise pass and thrashing the ball high into the roof of the net. It was his most famous Chelsea goal and it won us the Cup Winners’ Cup. Our first ever Champions League quarter-final tie paired us with the might of Barcelona. Zola inspired an extraordinary performance with a trademark free-kick that dipped over the wall and into the Shed End net. We were 3-0 up by the break at an ecstatic Stamford Bridge in what will go down as one of Chelsea’s greatest halves of football ever. Not many goals leave people speechless, but Zola managed just that in an FA Cup tie against Norwich in 2002. He met Graeme Le Saux’s low corner on the full with a backflicked volley that fizzed past Rob Green in a flash. It wasn’t until the replay was shown on the big screen at Stamford Bridge that the audacity and execution of the finish was evident. Zola finished as he started. Just as his first Chelsea goal had the Bridge faithful in awe, so did his last. With Chelsea cruising against Everton in our quest to finish in the top four, Zola raced down the left and, from an improbable angle, lofted the bouncing ball over Richard Wright in the Everton goal. It was the kind of moment of magic Zola had deservedly earned a reputation as producing on a regular basis. Zola’s final game for the Blues was a huge one as we hosted Liverpool at the Bridge with the final spot in the Champions League places up for grabs. We led 2-1 when Zola came off the bench and, with time ticking down, danced between a gaggle of red shirts, including a bewildered Jamie Carragher, in a clip that has stood the test of time to go viral in the modern age. It epitomised his genius. When Zola met Carragher... ✨ pic.twitter.com/3Dpxv9VSIE
news.body_zh: 简单地说，詹弗兰科·佐拉是切尔西最好的球员之一。在签约 30 周年之际，正是重温佐拉在伦敦西部辉煌职业生涯的最佳时机。这位意大利魔术师于 1996 年 11 月 8 日从帕尔马抵达，并在近七年后离开，成为历史上的伟大人物，一系列不可磨灭的时刻巩固了他在我们历史书中的地位。将他们缩小到候选名单并不是一件容易的事——任何有幸观看佐拉为我们比赛的人都会唤起对他天才的不同回忆。但按照时间顺序，这里有 11 个我们认为最突出的时刻……佐拉在切尔西的第一个进球预示着即将发生的事情。站在 35 码外的任意球面前，很少有人会给他机会破门——但当时我们并不知道他在定位球方面的能力有多大。他的射门充满了鞭子和倾斜，使得埃弗顿的门将内维尔·索撒尔和一名后卫在旋转中匆忙撤退到罚球线上，切尔西张大了嘴。两周后，佐拉的独创性再次让斯坦福桥惊叹不已。这一次，他从右路被释放，然后将头发花白的西汉姆联后卫朱利安·迪克斯从里到外，沉着地射门。 “当时我不知道朱利安·迪克斯是谁，”几年后吉安弗兰科开玩笑说。 “如果我知道的话，我可能就不会那么做了，因为这太危险了！”很少有人能像佐拉在 97 年 2 月英超联赛比赛的第二分钟那样让这支上世纪九十年代伟大的曼联队看起来如此愚蠢。他首先切入滑动的丹尼斯·欧文，然后轻松越过加里·帕利斯特，佐拉微妙的触球使他失去了平衡。随后的射门非常有力，射门越过近门柱处的彼得·舒梅切尔。佐拉在切尔西的职业生涯还不到六个月，就已经积累了一系列令人羡慕的精彩进球。可以说，没有人能比他在海布里击败温布尔登的足总杯半决赛中令人眼花缭乱的表现更出色。佐拉在球门附近跑动，接到罗伯托·迪马特奥的传球，他的第一次触球不知何故将球弹回了相反的方向，并在他转移体重时回到了他的路径上。再触碰一下，然后砰地一声——球进了温网！佐拉在英格兰的首个赛季吸引了球迷和专家的关注，以至于该国的记者将他远远地选为足球作家协会年度最佳球员——佐拉的得票数是儒尼尼奥和我们自己的马克·休斯的两倍。那个赛季，他还为意大利队在温布利对阵英格兰队的比赛中攻入致胜进球。我们在温布利战胜米德尔斯堡的足总杯决赛中，埃迪·牛顿近距离将球射入球门，我们获得了一代人以来的第一座重要奖杯。这个进球很大程度上要归功于佐拉的威严，他巧妙地将丹·佩特雷斯库的传中弹回六码禁区内，让牛顿将球射入。佐拉最著名的切尔西进球是在 1998 年优胜者杯决赛上场后不到 20 秒就打进的。他不失时机地发起冲击，接住丹尼斯·怀斯的传球，将球高高打入网顶。这是他最著名的切尔西进球，帮助我们赢得了优胜者杯。我们的第一次欧冠四分之一决赛让我们与巴塞罗那的实力相媲美。佐拉凭借标志性的任意球激发了一场非凡的表演，该球越过了人墙并落入了谢德恩德的球网。中场休息时，我们在欣喜若狂的斯坦福桥以 3-0 领先，这将成为切尔西足球史上最伟大的半场之一。没有多少进球让人哑口无言，但佐拉在 2002 年足总杯对阵诺维奇的比赛中做到了这一点。他在全场接格雷姆·勒索克斯的低角，一记后弹凌空抽射过了罗布·格林。直到斯坦福桥大屏幕上重播时，比赛的大胆和执行力才得以显现。佐拉开始时也结束了。正如他在切尔西的第一个进球让蓝桥球迷惊叹不已，他的最后一个进球也是如此。当切尔西在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中力争进入前四名时，佐拉从左路冲下，从一个不可思议的角度将弹起的皮球越过埃弗顿球门的理查德·赖特。正是这种神奇的时刻，佐拉当之无愧地赢得了定期产出的声誉。 佐拉为蓝军的最后一场比赛是一场重要的比赛，我们在桥上迎战利物浦，欧冠最后一个席位有待争夺。当佐拉替补出场时，我们以2-1领先，随着时间的流逝，他在一群红衫军之间跳舞，其中包括困惑的杰米·卡拉格，这段视频经受了时间的考验，在现代迅速走红。这集中体现了他的天才。当佐拉遇见卡拉格......✨ pic.twitter.com/3Dpxv9VSIE

news.title: Five of Chelsea's most memorable moments against Sunderland
news.title_zh: 切尔西对阵桑德兰最难忘的五个时刻
news.body_en: Sunderland may have only been an opponent of ours in just over half of the Premier League seasons to date, but the Black Cats have been on the receiving end of some iconic Chelsea moments. We first played Sunderland in the Premier League in 1996/97, recording a memorable 6-2 victory at Stamford Bridge. Since then, there have been goals, performances and top-flight title celebrations that will live long in the memory. Here we bring you the top five… Chelsea 4-0 Sunderland7 August 1999 The sun was shining at Stamford Bridge as Chelsea, tipped for the title by some, started the new season in style by sinking newly-promoted Sunderland. Gus Poyet, Gianfranco Zola and Tore Andre Flo had already given us an unassailable lead when Poyet bagged the goal of the game. Zola scooped the ball over the Mackems’ defence and into the path of Poyet, who expertly scissor-kicked his volley into the top corner. In creation and execution, it was simply sublime. Chelsea 7-2 Sunderland16 January 2010 In a season full of goals, Ashley Cole’s against Sunderland at the turn of the year was voted by supporters as the best, and it was easy to see why. From inside his own half, John Terry put a lofted first-time pass into the path of the marauding left-back. Running at full tilt didn’t stop Cole bringing the ball under his spell with an immaculate first touch. As Sunderland skipper Lorik Cana slid across to block the shot, Cole calmly cut the ball inside him before using the outside of his left boot to find the far corner. Sunderland 3-4 Chelsea4 December 2013 Singling out one Eden Hazard performance for Chelsea is no easy task, but his display at the Stadium of Light in December 2013 arguably stands above the rest. After providing an assist for Frank Lampard, Hazard netted two individual goals of the highest quality to help us to a 4-3 win. His second goal, again after combining with Lampard, was particularly magical. He instinctively and ecstatically ripped off his shirt in celebration, a sure sign even the cool Belgian was impressed by his masterclass on Wearside. Chelsea 3-1 Sunderland24 May 2015 Both of our most recent Premier League trophy lifts have come after final-day victories over Sunderland at Stamford Bridge. The first was in May 2015, when a penalty from Diego Costa and a Loic Remy brace secured a 3-1 success after we had gone behind early. One of the many highlights that day was the sight of Didier Drogba being carried off the pitch by his team-mates after his final Chelsea appearance. History would repeat itself two years later… Chelsea 5-1 SunderlandMay 21 2017 On that occasion, it was John Terry who was celebrated off the Stamford Bridge turf 26 minutes into his final game, which would prove a resounding victory over the relegated Black Cats. Again, we went behind. Again, we hit back in style. Willian levelled with an angle finish before goals from Eden Hazard and Pedro, two of the stars of the season, had us in control as the contest drew to a close. Michy Batshuayi, whose goal at West Brom a week earlier secured the title, added a late double as the celebrations started in earnest once more.
news.body_zh: 迄今为止，桑德兰可能只在半个多半的英超赛季中成为我们的对手，但黑猫队却成为了切尔西的一些标志性时刻的接受者。我们第一次在英超联赛中对阵桑德兰是在 1996/97 赛季，当时我们在斯坦福桥以 6-2 取得了令人难忘的胜利。从那时起，我们的进球、表现和顶级联赛冠军庆祝活动将永远留在人们的记忆中。在此，我们为您带来前五名…… 切尔西 4-0 桑德兰 1999 年 8 月7 日 斯坦福桥阳光明媚，一些人认为切尔西将夺冠，但他们却以击败升班马桑德兰的方式华丽地开始了新赛季。当波耶特攻入本场比赛的进球时，格斯·波耶特、吉安弗兰科·佐拉和托雷·安德烈·弗洛已经为我们带来了无懈可击的领先优势。佐拉将球越过麦克姆斯的防守，传到波耶特的路径上，波耶特熟练地用剪刀脚将球射入球门上角。在创作和执行上，它简直是崇高的。切尔西 7-2 桑德兰 2010 年 1 月 16 日 在一个充满进球的赛季中，阿什利·科尔在岁末年初对阵桑德兰的比赛被球迷票选为最佳进球，原因显而易见。约翰·特里在本方半场内首次将一记高高传球传给了这位掠夺性的左后卫。全速奔跑并没有阻止科尔以完美的第一次触球将球带入他的魔力之中。当桑德兰队队长洛里克·卡纳横身挡出射门时，科尔冷静地将球内切，然后用左靴外侧找到远角。桑德兰 3-4 切尔西 2013 年 12 月4 日 切尔西队中挑出阿扎尔的表现绝非易事，但他在 2013 年 12 月在光明球场的表现可以说是遥遥领先。在为弗兰克·兰帕德送出助攻后，阿扎尔打进了两个最高质量的个人进球，帮助我们以4-3获胜。他的第二个进球，再次与兰帕德联手后，特别神奇。他本能地、欣喜若狂地脱掉衬衫以示庆祝，这无疑表明即使是这位冷静的比利时人也对他在威尔赛德的大师班印象深刻。切尔西 3-1 桑德兰 2015 年 5 月 24 日 我们最近两次捧起英超奖杯都是在斯坦福桥最后一天战胜桑德兰之后取得的。第一次是在2015年5月，当时我们早早落后，迭戈·科斯塔的点球和卢伊克·雷米的梅开二度帮助球队以3-1获胜。那天的众多亮点之一是迪迪埃·德罗巴在切尔西最后一次出场后被队友抬出球场。两年后历史将重演……切尔西 5-1 桑德兰 2017 年 5 月 21 日在那场比赛中，约翰·特里在他的最后一场比赛进行到第 26 分钟时在斯坦福桥草坪上庆祝，这将证明这是对降级黑猫队的一场彻底胜利。我们又落后了。我们再次以时尚的方式反击。威廉以角度射门扳平比分，随后本赛季的两位球星阿扎尔和佩德罗的进球让我们控制了比赛，比赛接近尾声。米奇·巴舒亚伊一周前在西布朗队的进球确保了冠军头衔，在庆祝活动再次正式开始时，他在比赛最后时刻打进了两粒进球。

news.title: Erin Cuthbert: 'There will be a reaction'
news.title_zh: 艾琳·卡斯伯特：“会有反应”
news.body_en: Chelsea captain Erin Cuthbert reflected on a disappointing stalemate against Everton on Saturday afternoon, but vowed the side would bounce back against Hacken in the Women's Champions League on Tuesday. The skipper started the match for only the second time this season after recovering from a knee injury sustained in the summer and was substituted for Aggie Beever-Jones after 74 minutes with the Blues chasing a goal. Despite our best efforts, it was not to be, and Cuthbert gave her thoughts after the final whistle. She said: 'We did really well at getting ourselves ahead in the first half. That’s been our target: to score early, and then we conceded an unfortunate goal, which is no one’s fault. But we need to do a little bit more. 'We weren’t quite on the same page today defensively. We weren’t pressing as a group, as we have done in the previous games. We were a bit sloppy on the ball, too. 'But I can’t fault anybody’s effort. The effort has been there. It’s just one of those days where we were really not at it, and we can’t have too many of those if we want to be in a title race.' The teams went in with the scores at 1-1 during the interval after a Lucy Bronze own goal had cancelled out Sandy Baltimore's opener. Everton could then afford to sit back during the second half, meaning Chelsea were stuck trying to find a winner. 'You can’t get too stressed,' Cuthbert explained. 'I feel like as players we tend to look at scoreboards and things start to slip away. But you’ll always get a chance, and we had a few half-chances here and there today. We were dangerous on set pieces. We obviously scored from Katie's (McCabe) cross as well. 'But you have games where you just grind out results. You don’t always have to be at your best throughout the whole season, as long as you’re getting the results. But we didn’t have that today, and we can’t have too many more of those.' There is very little time for the team to linger over today's result, with a trip to Sweden on the horizon and a game against Hacken on Tuesday night. As captain, Cuthbert will take responsibility for lifting the spirits and making sure we are ready for that challenge, before returning to Stamford Bridge to face Manchester City next weekend. 'There’s going to be a reaction, for sure,' she said. 'There’s a lot of unhappy people in the dressing room, and rightly so, because this is a club that expects to win games of football. But just the quality was lacking for us today, myself included. If we all looked at ourselves in the dressing room, we all know that we could have done a lot better today. 'I’m sure that we’ll be back at training tomorrow, ready and fully focused on Hacken. We will make sure that we put our best foot forward come Tuesday night.'
news.body_zh: 切尔西队长艾琳·库斯伯特回顾了周六下午对阵埃弗顿的令人失望的平局，但发誓球队将在周二的女子冠军联赛中对阵哈肯。这位队长在从夏天的膝伤中恢复后，本赛季仅第二次首发出场，并在第 74 分钟蓝军追平比分时被阿吉·比弗-琼斯替换下场。尽管我们尽了最大努力，但事实并非如此，库斯伯特在终场哨响后表达了她的想法。她说：“我们在上半场取得领先方面做得非常好。这一直是我们的目标：尽早进球，然后我们不幸失球，这不是任何人的错。但我们还需要做更多的事情。 “今天我们在防守上并没有达成一致。我们没有像前几场比赛那样作为一个整体进行压迫。我们对球也有点马虎。 “但我不能责怪任何人的努力。努力已经在那里了。这只是我们真的没有参加的那些日子之一，如果我们想参加冠军争夺战，我们就不能有太多这样的日子。中场休息时，露西·青铜的乌龙球抵消了桑迪·巴尔的摩的首开纪录，两队以 1-1 的比分进入比赛。埃弗顿在下半场可以袖手旁观，这意味着切尔西陷入了寻找胜利者的困境。 “你不能压力太大，”卡斯伯特解释道。 “我觉得作为球员，我们倾向于看记分牌，但事情开始溜走。但你总会有机会的，今天我们到处都有一些半机会。我们在定位球上很危险。显然我们也从凯蒂（麦凯布）的传中得分。 “但有些游戏只是磨出结果。只要你取得了成果，你不必在整个赛季中始终保持最佳状态。但我们今天没有这样的东西，而且我们也不能再有太多这样的东西了。”球队几乎没有时间去思考今天的结果，即将前往瑞典，并在周二晚上对阵哈肯的比赛。作为队长，卡斯伯特将负责振奋精神并确保我们为迎接挑战做好准备，然后下周末返回斯坦福桥对阵曼城。 “肯定会有反应，”她说。 “更衣室里有很多不高兴的人，这是正确的，因为这是一家希望赢得足球比赛的俱乐部。但今天的我们，包括我自己，都缺乏质量。如果我们都在更衣室里审视自己，我们都知道我们今天可以做得更好。 “我确信我们明天会回到训练场，做好准备并完全专注于哈肯。我们将确保周二晚上尽最大努力。”

news.title: Alonso on Lavia’s ‘brain for the team’ and his next step
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈拉维亚的“团队大脑”和他的下一步
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has emphasised Romeo Lavia's growing importance in his Chelsea side, highlighting the midfielder's recent development while insisting there is still more to come. Lavia was excellent in our previous two matches, against Liverpool and Manchester United, with the added bonus that he completed the 90 minutes in both. It has reinforced the belief that Lavia is establishing himself as a key controller in the heart of our midfield, and that consistency and rhythm is something Alonso knows from personal experience will only help his team. ‘I always have the feeling that every time the midfield area works, the team works better,’ Alonso said. ‘Romeo is in a very good place, not just the last game. I think that for the last month he's been very consistent in his performance. ‘He's been very important for the team because in the middle you need to have a brain for yourself, but a brain for the team. He's good with the ball, he's giving balance, and he's connecting really well with the players around him. ‘It's not rocket science to know that once you have good midfielders, the team normally looks better.’ Despite Lavia’s eye-catching displays, our manager has made it clear he will continue to demand higher standards from the Belgian international to ensure his ceiling is reached. He said: ‘We need to push him. We need to help him continue so he can take the next step, because it’s not enough yet. ‘There's been a change, and he knows that,’ added Alonso when asked if Lavia is doing anything differently. ‘He has realised that's the way.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索强调了罗密欧·拉维亚在切尔西队中日益重要的地位，强调了这位中场球员最近的发展，同时坚称还有更多的进步。拉维亚在我们之前对阵利物浦和曼联的两场比赛中表现出色，而且他在两场比赛中都踢满了 90 分钟。这增强了人们的信念，拉维亚正在将自己打造成我们中场核心的关键控制者，而阿隆索从个人经验中知道，一致性和节奏只会对他的球队有所帮助。 “我总有一种感觉，每当中场区域发挥作用时，球队就会表现得更好，”阿隆索说。 “罗密欧处于一个非常好的位置，而不仅仅是最后一场比赛。我认为上个月他的表现非常稳定。 “他对球队非常重要，因为在中间你需要有自己的大脑，但也有球队的大脑。他控球能力很好，能够保持平衡，并且与周围的球员联系得很好。 “知道一旦拥有优秀的中场球员，球队通常会看起来更好，这并不是火箭科学。”尽管拉维亚表现出色，但我们的主教练已明确表示，他将继续对这位比利时国脚提出更高的标准，以确保达到他的上限。他说：‘我们需要推动他。我们需要帮助他继续前进，以便他可以采取下一步，因为这还不够。当被问及拉维亚是否做了任何不同的事情时，阿隆索补充道，“发生了变化，他知道这一点。” “他已经意识到就是这样。”

news.title: Frustrated Bompastor: 'We were not clinical or ruthless enough'
news.title_zh: 沮丧的邦帕斯托：“我们不够冷静或不够冷酷”
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor was left feeling frustrated by our 1-1 draw with Everton at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon, but felt it was an opportunity to reflect and improve before Tuesday night's Women's Champions League trip to Hacken in Sweden. The head coach said in her pre-match press conference the Toffees would be hard to break down, and that proved to be true until Sandy Baltimore broke the deadlock after 28 minutes. Yet an unfortunate own goal from Lucy Bronze levelled things up almost immediately afterwards, and Chelsea were once again forced to battle through their block. While Chelsea's unbeaten run in the WSL was extended to 17 games, and we remain undefeated in all competitions this season, Bompastor took the opportunity to reflect on the draw after the game and pointed to the areas where she felt her side were below par this afternoon. 'The result is really frustrating for us,' she said. 'Today the performance was not good enough for us to get a better result. We were probably too slow. We had 20 shots on goal, eight on target, but even when we shot on target we were not clinical enough, not ruthless enough, and I don’t think we made Everton's goalkeeper work hard enough. 'Also, the connection between the players didn’t really click today. So it happens. When we have a performance like that, it’s good for us to provide feedback and to be honest and realistic about what happened on the pitch. 'In terms of the defensive aspects, today we were not compact enough as a block. We didn’t recover enough balls in terms of the high press. So that’s something we need to do better going into the next game. 'Without the ball, we conceded an unfortunate goal, but it was the goal that allowed them to get a point from this game. So it happens sometimes. As much as we are frustrated, now it’s for us to analyse the game, take the feedback, and move on to the next one.' Despite the initial disappointment of dropping points, the head coach did point to some positives to take from the game. Chelsea kept Everton to zero shots on target throughout the 90 minutes, even if we struggled to break through their low block. And with a match against Hacken to play on Tuesday night, there's no time to dwell on today's result. 'If we analyse from the beginning of the season, we had many games where we had a lot of good performances and a lot of quality on the pitch,' she continued. 'So it’s good for us when we are doing well not to go too high and when we have a frustrating result, not to go too low. Because I believe this team has a lot of quality, and we can do better than what we did today. 'Sometimes it's good not to always perform at a good level because it means you still have work to be done, and you need that. For me, it’s best when you have a frustrating result to play quickly straight afterwards. So the quick turnaround is actually a positive thing. You can quickly move on and focus on what is next.'
news.body_zh: 周六下午我们在斯坦福桥1-1战平埃弗顿，索尼娅·邦帕斯特感到沮丧，但她认为这是在周二晚上前往瑞典哈肯的女子冠军联赛之前反思和提高的机会。主教练在赛前新闻发布会上表示，太妃糖很难打破，事实证明这一点是正确的，直到桑迪·巴尔的摩在第28分钟打破僵局。然而，露西·青铜不幸的乌龙球几乎立即将比分扳平，切尔西再次被迫通过防守进行战斗。虽然切尔西在 WSL 中的不败纪录已延长至 17 场，并且我们在本赛季的所有比赛中保持不败，但 Bompastor 借此机会在赛后反思了平局，并指出了她认为今天下午球队低于标准杆的地方。 “结果对我们来说确实令人沮丧，”她说。 “今天的表现还不够好，我们无法取得更好的结果。我们可能太慢了。我们有20次射门，其中8次射正，但即使我们射中目标，我们也不够冷静，不够无情，而且我认为我们没有让埃弗顿的门将足够努力。 “此外，今天球员之间的联系并没有真正融洽。所以它发生了。当我们有这样的表现时，提供反馈并对球场上发生的事情保持诚实和现实是有好处的。 “在防守方面，今天我们的防守不够紧凑。在高位逼抢方面，我们没有收回足够的球权。所以这是我们在下一场比赛中需要做得更好的事情。 “在没有球的情况下，我们丢了一个不幸的球，但正是这个进球让他们在这场比赛中拿到了一分。所以有时会发生这种情况。尽管我们很沮丧，但现在我们需要分析游戏，获取反馈，然后继续下一场比赛。”尽管最初的失分令人失望，但主教练确实指出了从比赛中可以看到的一些积极因素。切尔西在整个 90 分钟内让埃弗顿保持零射门，即使我们很难突破他们的低位防守。周二晚上将有一场对阵哈肯的比赛，所以没有时间细想今天的结果。 “如果我们从赛季初开始分析，我们在很多比赛中都有出色的表现，并且在球场上也表现出色，”她继续说道。 “因此，当我们表现良好时，不要走得太高，当我们的成绩令人沮丧时，不要走得太低，这对我们有好处。因为我相信这支球队有很多素质，我们可以做得比今天更好。 “有时候，不总是表现出色是件好事，因为这意味着你还有工作要做，而且你需要这样做。对我来说，当你得到令人沮丧的结果时，最好是在事后立即快速比赛。因此，快速周转实际上是一件积极的事情。您可以快速继续前进并专注于下一步。”

news.title: Match report: Chelsea Women 1-1 Everton
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西女足 1-1 埃弗顿
news.body_en: With a defensive record only bettered by Chelsea in the WSL this season, the Blues knew we would be in for a tough afternoon against Everton even before the match had kicked off, and so it proved as we had to settle for a point at Stamford Bridge. After a cagey first half hour, Sandy Baltimore broke the deadlock when a small connection on the ball saw her steer home from a Lucy Bronze header back across goal. It felt like Chelsea were on our way, but when Bronze took an unfortunate touch from a looping ball in, the Toffees were back on level terms just four minutes later, and the teams went in at 1-1 at the break. Despite Everton not managing a shot on target during the match, the visitors made things really difficult for the Blues, reducing us to half-chances throughout. Their efforts were rewarded as they kept us from adding to the scoreline and took a point away from the Bridge. Sonia Bompastor made four alterations to her starting XI, swapping Veerle Buurman, Nathalie Bjorn and Sjoeke Nusken for Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan and Erin Cuthbert. Lauren James had unfortunately been ruled out with a hamstring injury earlier in the week, and Wieke Kaptein came into the line-up in her place. The head coach had mentioned in her pre-match press conference that she expected the visitors to defend well, and that's exactly what happened in the opening stages of the game as the Toffees played in a compact formation as they attempted to negate our strengths. Our first real attempt came from one of Ellie Carpenter's trademark runs down the flank, and as she let fly with a shot, only a tiny deflection from the defender saw it bounce just wide of the right-hand post. Melvine Malard was next to go close with a header that was just off target, but the offside flag went up soon afterwards to confirm that it wouldn't have counted. It wasn't going to be easy to break Everton down, but the Blues were getting closer. After a superb one-two with Carpenter, Kaptein blasted her shot towards goal but had her attempt cleared off the line. Our opener came soon afterwards. After we took a short corner, Katie McCabe swung a cross into the back post to find the head of Bronze. The centre-back cushioned her header across the face of goal, allowing Baltimore to nod home with the slightest of touches. Yet the Toffees hit back when a looping cross from Yuka Momiki took an unfortunate touch off Bronze and deflected into the back of the net. Our number 22 almost cancelled out the own goal with a bullet header seven minutes before the break, but an impressive stop saw Everton goalkeeper Courtney Brosnan tip the attempt over the bar. After another tight opening to the second half, Bompastor made a double substitution after 55 minutes, introducing Nusken and Thompson for Baltimore and Kaptein. The clock ticked towards 70 and, other than a series of corners, the Blues were yet to put any real pressure on a resolute Everton defence. When the Blues were awarded a free-kick for a late challenge on Carpenter, McCabe took it short to Thompson just outside her, and the American laid the ball off to Walsh. The midfielder bent in a curling shot, but Brosnan was able to collect. That was the only real danger we caused in the second half as the statistics showed we fired 21 shots on goal but ended the match with only three big chances created. It was a frustrating day, but we will look to regain top spot when we face leaders Manchester City next weekend in the WSL. We drop to second in the table, two points behind leaders Manchester City, following their 5-0 win over West Ham United earlier today. We travel to Sweden to face Hacken in the Women's Champions League on Tuesday, with kick-off set for 5.45pm UK time. We will then back at Stamford Bridge for our top-of-the-table clash with Man City next Saturday. Tickets are still available and you can secure your place here.
